Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates volume loss in the left hemithorax consistent with prior left upper lobe resection, characterized by elevation of the left hemidiaphragm and a compensatory shift of the mediastinum toward the left side. This morphological pattern of ipsilateral shift and diaphragmatic elevation confirms option B, while options suggesting overinflation or contralateral shift are inconsistent with the observed anatomy.
